what: The pages under You, one route so a push or a link opens any of them: payouts, insights (By site, worth, goal), records, connections (Your sites), rules (Rules and limits), log (Activity), settings.

frame.who: The person clearing out reaches Payouts and Your sites after a sale or a sign-out; the person holding a minimum checks Rules and limits for their lowest; the flipper reads By site and Records; anyone leaving uses Settings.
frame.how_often: Rarely, each one: a page is opened to change one thing or check one number, then left.
frame.came_to: Change one setting or limit, link a site, undo one automatic step, or download the year's sales.
frame.costly_mistake: A price set without the person's tap (limits end in Approve); a rule turned on before the person approved it three times without a change (its switch is disabled and says why); deleting an account while a sale is open (refused, and says so).
frame.ways_out: spec/ways-out.md: Pause selling (away mode where a site has one, end and bring back elsewhere, never relisting on Poshmark), quiet hours (a deadline inside them comes before), never suggest photo edits, units and currency, delete (refused while a sale is open), a site's 2FA or captcha (Try again or leave it), unlink a site (Undo for a few seconds).
frame.in_the_loop: Rules and limits is where the hand-off line is drawn and moved: what runs alone with a switch, what always asks without one, and each item's lowest price, saved only on Approve. Activity shows every automatic step with Undo while it can be undone where it happened.

decisions: One route for every page under You, so a push or a link opens any directly (spec/pages.md §1, rule 2); each page is its own file in app/src/you/.
By site, worth and the goal share one page: three short subjects that fit in under three screens (spec/pages.md §1, rule 4).
Sites are their logos with their state in words, never their names in words (C5); every row runs on its own, so one sign-in never blocks the rest (Ben, 03:22).
The demo's first Link on Mercari stops at the site's code step and times out, so the error and Try again can be seen and tested; the second try links.
A linked site's row opens a sheet whose one act is Unlink, with Undo after: leaving should be one tap and reversible (ways-out, Get me out).
A rule can be switched on only once it has 3 unedited approvals; below that its switch is disabled and its line says the count (decisions: tiers that learn; only unedited approvals count).
The never-alone kinds are listed with no switch, so the person sees the line the agent never crosses.
The floor and the always-accept line are the agent's guesses until the person changes them, so they show as Guess fields (dotted), and they save only on Approve: a price is never set without a tap.
The ceiling here is the always-accept line: above it an offer is taken at once, below the floor it always asks. The buyer's ceiling (most you'd pay) belongs to Want and Buy.
Notification channels are three pills in a sheet, not a new part: a choice of three that closes on the tap.
Delete account is refused while a sale is open, as deleting an item is (ways-out, Delete it); otherwise it says what ends first and waits for Approve.
Pause selling picks a date two weeks out as its guess, shown as a Guess field the person can change.
Records keeps its foot button for the CSV: the one act on the page, labelled a record.
